findings.issue: 表 meaning 'outside/front' (表に出る = 'step outside') is read おもて; ひょう is the reading for 'chart/table' and is impossible here. The token gloss itself says 'outside, the exterior'.
Reading of 表 is おもて ('outside/front'), matching the gloss 'outside, the exterior'; ひょう ('chart/table') is wrong in this sentence.
Propagates the wrong ひょう reading; 表に = omote ni here.
何時に asking clock time (followed by に, translated 'what time / a que horas', token glossed 'what time') must be read なんじ. いつ ('when') is not used with に in this sense; correct reading is なんじにいきましょうか.
findings.current: いつにいきましょうか。
findings.suggested: なんじにいきましょうか。

findings.issue: 何時 here is なんじ (clock time; the token's own gloss is 'what time / que horas'), not いつ ('when').
Propagates the wrong いつ reading; 何時に = nanji ni ('at what o'clock').

Note (both pt-BR and en) misidentifies the lemma: the imperative of ichidan つける is つけろ/つけよ, never bare つけ. つけ here is the imperative of godan つく 'to side with / stick to' — which matches the token's own glosses ('to stick, adhere' / 'atrelar-se, aderir') and the en 'stick with'.
findings.current: forma imperativa de つける ('prender/atrelar'); a base つけ funciona como ordem 'atrele!'
findings.suggested: forma imperativa de つく ('aderir a, ficar do lado de'); つけ = ordem 'fique do lado (dos fortes)!'

findings.issue: 意地が悪い means mean/spiteful/ill-natured (en: 'nasty piece of work'); 'ter um gênio ruim' in BR Portuguese reads as bad-tempered/irritable — a different personality trait, so the nuance is misleading.
findings.current: Não parece, mas na verdade ele tem um gênio ruim.
findings.suggested: Não parece, mas na verdade ele é maldoso.

findings.issue: 'Cidade-toda' renders 町中 as まちじゅう ('whole town'), but the kana and token gloss read it as まちなか ('pela cidade / no meio da cidade'; lit_en 'around town'). The literal mirror contradicts the chosen reading.
findings.current: Cidade-toda passeio/turismo (ou algo assim) fazemos, hein?
